maintenance_led.reason: Sells refined cane sugar and sweeteners to food manufacturers; consumable product, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private food and beverage manufacturers buying sugar; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through refinery capacity, supply chain integration and supply agreements, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Refined sugar is largely a commodity input; food manufacturers can switch refiners, though logistics and specs add some friction.

notes: Sucro's recent history is less certain to me, so the answers rely mostly on the website text.
